summary: Anfield Energy Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on TSX-V/NASDAQ, furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 1, 2026 press release reporting a Colorado DRMS decision letter dated September 29, 2026 that concluded review of the 112d-1 Hard Rock Reclamation Permit application for its past-producing JD-8 uranium-vanadium mine, approving a 28.30-acre permit and affected area and setting a US$620,000 financial warranty. The permit issues upon verified surety; DOE NEPA review advances, targeting Q2 2027 restart. No securities transaction, no special-situation event.
